General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Genuine Suzuki OEM Part
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Seat Headrest for the Samurai JL/JA Model and the SJ410 Model
These will fit into your existing Samurai OEM seat

Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Seat Headrests (Driver & Passenger Sides)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 JL/JA Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
